g.text: A V2 commit edits one search path of the history radix
the key of the outgoing current state c is above every historical key, so its search path takes the largest edge at every node
current c, count n, root r
current c', count n + 1, root r'
key(c) continues s ‖ b' with b' > b,
so it leaves this prefix at b
leaf, prefix u': the rest of key(c)
the old entry, beside the path
loaded nodes = the old search path {r, n1, L1} = 3
emitted nodes = the new search path {r', n1', m, Lc}
reused child references = 2 + 2 + 0 - (3 - 1) = 2: X and Y,
The count comes from the CAS outcome
one insertion (Absent to Multiplicity) adds one:
, even when Lc is an object the
history already stores and nothing new is inserted
